# GitHub community configuration

Keep public collaboration and automation configuration here:

- [Issue forms](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/GUIDELINES.md) collect reproducible bugs, workflow proposals, and evidence corrections.
- [Pull request template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md) records scope, evidence, validation, and publication checks.
- `CODEOWNERS` requests the maintainer's review; it does not enforce merge protection by itself.
- [Workflows](workflows/GUIDELINES.md) validate the reusable public template.

See [contributing](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for fork and maintainer workflows and [security policy](../SECURITY.md) for private reporting. Research records and credentials belong outside public issues, pull requests, and workflow inputs.
